issue.title: Bank badge for every stats strip
issue.description: Every stats strip (the Day strip in daily `bob-plan` blocks, `bob-day-stats` fences, and every `bob-stats-strip` fence on week, quarter, year, and all-time notes) is followed by one read-only Bank Badge for exactly that strip's period. Each badge shows only the in/out parts above $0.00, is hidden when nothing was counted and nothing is waiting, is colored by a calm, documented in/out rule, names partial coverage, and opens the rows behind it without writing. A Bank Badge glossary term and a color decision record describe it.

payload.entry: LAND AUDIT before remaining-work tale: Read the epic and all four children, every child note, and the approved plan; parent_id is null. Reviewed bob-cli commits 28f48be9, 575f9e66 and 9a6013a2 plus bob-plugins 008700b and 6a1778b against the Rust CLI/report/output/tests, plugin decoder/model/painter/navigation/fence lifecycle and docs. The authorized Bank Badge/Day Strip/Stats Strip glossary changes exist; no rejected color decision record was added. Non-epic drift since the first epic commit is bob-cli 74a5db16 and 50b015b1 (documentation refreshes), already incorporated; no later unrelated plugin commit at 6a1778b. The bank JSON index and stats.bank_badge/alias config reference still need integration. Independent verification: 104 targeted plugin tests passed, build:check passed, npm run docs:check passed all gates (447 doc unit tests passed, 1 optional fonts skip), and the missing-Chromium production DOM test exits 0 with one explicit skip. No current --epic-symbol entries. Full just check is reserved for the corrected tree; just check-full was not run. Remaining epic defects: (1) a W45 report is rendered for W46 because bankBadgeModel only matches kind outside day; (2) painter real textContent concatenates in+,015.00/out,362.56/1waiting and has no whole-part wrapping rule; (3) without IntersectionObserver, a hidden W46 fence shown later by periodStripCheckAll never subscribes until an unrelated bank refresh (reproduced through the host harness); (4) source audit proves a future-only account/no-row all-time range can have start>end, but non-summary build loops until equality or chrono maximum rather than producing empty days. Plan sase_plan_bank_badge_closeout.md is a medium tale covering only those repairs, reference integration, verification, and this epic closeout in its coder turn.

Note 3 splits into: (a) real Obsidian week/quarter E2E unavailable, an explicitly allowed plan limitation, not a new defect; (b) sheet-sequence-dom missing Chromium now skips successfully (exit 0, one skip), so no reopening of closed bob-cli-f1; (c) historical performance failures belong to existing bob-cli-km, bob-cli-ki and bob-cli-ju, each received an attributed evidence note, with no invented independent failing run/+1 and no duplicate task. The blanket 25ms wording is inaccurate for the latter two nodes (their task descriptions govern). Phase .2's general performance note is the same limitation. Carry these outcomes into the eventual close note. Exact painter reproduction for audit note 1: DOM textContent BANK·in+$2,015.00·out$1,362.56·1waiting, versus model BANK · in +$2,015.00 · out $1,362.56 · 1 waiting. The epic remains open pending the validated remaining-work tale and final check. No parent bead at audit time.
